spans.s: ] A clod, a lump of earth; परद्रव्येषु लोष्टवत् यः पश्यति स पश्यति; समलोष्टकाञ्चनः
. -ष्टम् Rust of iron.-Comp. -गुटिका a pellet of clay. -घातः a blow with clod. -घ्नः, -भेदनः, -नम् an instrument for breaking clods, a harrow.
A particular object serving as a mark.
लोष्टायते [lōṣṭāyatē], Den. Ā. To be quite valueless.
लोष्टुः [lōṣṭuḥ], A clod, lump of earth.
लोष्ट् [lōṣṭ], 1 Ā. (लोष्टते) To heap up, accumulate.
